title: Pure coefficient coherence for a restricted inverse chart
statement: Let N>0, A be a commutative ring with NA=0, t be normalized finite Tate transport, S a Noetherian scheme with N invertible, and F a locally free module of rank d≥0. For U≤V and a frame e of F on V, write a=affineTraceMap(U→V,d), q=vectorIntegrationChart(e), K=vectorIntegrationCoefficient(F), c=vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient(e), and b for affineTraceRightBaseChange(U→V,d,1_V) followed by R_U of the constant-unit pullback. The inverse-image compositor (a≫q)*K→a*q*K, followed by a*(c.hom) and b.hom, equals vectorIntegrationCartesianCoefficient for the pasted inverse-frame square over U→S, with base coefficient affineLinearBaseCoefficient(S,d) and comparison vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback(U→S,d). This is an equality on the affine tower over U and involves no compact-support functor, exchange map or counit.

proof.text: Apply the affine tower unit coefficient comparison to rewrite the right base-change followed by constant-unit pullback as ordered Tate coefficient descent.
Apply the inverse-frame and pasted-square coefficient composition after that rewrite. Its expansion is exactly the Cartesian coefficient for the restricted chart.

theorem vectorIntegration_restricted_chart_coefficient
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (U V : S.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V)
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (affineTraceMap (S.homOfLE hUV) d) (vectorIntegrationChart S d F V e)).hom.app
        (vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d F) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (affineTraceMap (S.homOfLE hUV) d)).map
        (vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient A N hA t S hS d F V e).hom ≫
      (affineTraceRightBaseChange A N hA t (S.homOfLE hUV)
        (affineTracePullbackInvertible N V.ι hS) d (ordinaryFiniteUnit A V.toScheme)).hom ≫
      (affineTraceRight A N hA U.toScheme d).map
        (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (S.homOfLE hUV)).hom =
    (vectorIntegrationCartesianCoefficient A N hA t (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)
      U.ι (affineTracePullbackInvertible N U.ι hS) d
      (vectorIntegrationRestrictedChart S d F U V hUV e)
      (vectorIntegrationRestrictedChart_isPullback S d F U V hUV e)
      (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d)
      (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t U.ι hS d)).hom
